curated.category: 慢性心血管与血管疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 临床最常见持续性心律失常：本身一般不直接瞬时致命（极少数合并预激综合征旁路前传可恶化为室颤猝死），但左心耳血流淤滞极易形成血栓，脱落瞬间引发大血管闭塞性致命性缺血性脑卒中（房颤患者卒中风险增5倍且致死致残率远高于非房颤卒中），同时长期快速心室率可诱发心动过速性心肌病与慢性心力衰竭；GBD 2021估算全球全年龄段直接/归因于AF/AFL年死亡约338,947例（约33.9万例/年）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 采用‘ABC综合管理路径’（A抗凝防卒中、B更好症状与节律/心室率控制、C心血管共病管理）：集采DOAC极大普及了规范抗凝防卒中，早期射频/冷冻/脉冲电场导管消融在阵发性房颤可实现较高的长期窦律维持（功能性治愈率常达70%–80%）。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021估算全球全年龄段心房颤动与心房扑动（AF/AFL）年死亡约338,947例（约33.9万例/年，PMC12133759）
annual_deaths_global.source: IHME GBD 2021 (Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine 2025, PMC12133759)

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列全人群AF独立死亡统计（房颤所致致命结局主要体现于心源性缺血性脑卒中与心衰）；全国心律失常（以房颤为主）年住院直接花费约170亿–180亿元，房颤相关卒中患者年均直接医疗费用约3.04万元

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 血流动力学不稳定（低血压、心衰恶化或心绞痛）快速房颤立即同步电复律（120–200J）；伴预激综合征（WPW）宽QRS房颤严禁使用地高辛、维拉帕米、腺苷或胺碘酮/β阻滞剂静推以防诱发室颤，应首选同步电复律或普鲁卡因胺/伊布利特；常规急性期以静脉艾司洛尔/美托洛尔或胺碘酮控制心室率/转复并启动抗凝评估（CHA2DS2-VA评分）。

curated.name_zh: 社区获得性肺炎与重症肺炎
curated.category: 急性呼吸道感染 (Acute Respiratory Infection)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 普通轻中症CAP可经抗感染治愈，但高龄、免疫低下或病原毒力强患者可在数日内进展为重症肺炎合并呼吸衰竭及脓毒症休克。下呼吸道感染居全球死因第4位，中国ICU重症CAP 28–30天病死率约37%，需有创机械通气者超过60%。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 绝大多数细菌性、非典型病原及部分病毒性肺炎经及时恰当抗微生物药物及氧疗支持可完全治愈；但耐药菌、混合感染及高龄重症肺炎病死率依然突出。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO 2023年全球十大死因报告显示下呼吸道感染（含肺炎）位列第4位，年致死约270万例（GBD 2021估算约为218万例；WHO肺炎实况指出2019年5岁以下儿童死于肺炎达740,180例，占该年龄组死亡的14%）。
annual_deaths_global.source: WHO Top 10 Causes of Death Fact Sheet (2026) / GBD 2021

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021估算中国非COVID-19下呼吸道感染年死亡约206,930例（95% UI: 171,260–251,990），年发病约4,470万例次，绝大多数集中于老年人及婴幼儿。
annual_deaths_china.source: GBD 2021 China Lower Respiratory Infections Analysis (PMC12529499)

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球每年数亿人次下呼吸道感染发作，肺炎是全球感染性疾病致死及5岁以下儿童死亡的首要原因。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国成人CAP年发病率超过7/1,000人年，高龄人群（≥65岁）及婴幼儿住院率最高；秋冬季肺炎支原体与病毒共感染波动显著。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 依据CURB-65或IDSA/ATS重症肺炎标准快速分诊；重症患者立即吸氧/经鼻高流量湿化氧疗（HFNC）或无创/有创通气维持SpO2≥92%；4小时内（休克者1小时内）静脉启动经验性联合抗感染（如β-内酰胺类联用大环内酯类或呼吸喹诺酮类），并送检痰/支气管肺泡灌洗液培养及mNGS；合并休克及呼吸衰竭按脓毒症/ARDS方案抢救。

master.definition_en: Necrobiosis lipoidica is a rare skin disorder of collagen degeneration. It is characterized by a rash that occurs on the lower legs. It is more common in women, and there are usually several spots. They are slightly raised shiny red-brown patches. The centers are often yellowish and may develop open sores that are slow to heal. Infections can occur but are uncommon. Some patients have itching, pain, or abnormal sensations. It usually occurs more often in people with diabetes, in people with a family history of diabetes or a tendency to get diabetes, but can occur in nondiabetic people. About 11% to 65% of patients with necrobiosis lipoidica also have diabetes, but the exact cause is still not known. Treatment is difficult. The disease is typically chronic with variable progression and scarring.

master.definition_en: Familial spontaneous pneumothorax is a rare, genetic pulmonary disease characterized by the uni- or bilateral accumulation of air in the pleural cavity in persons with a positive family history and no underlying lung disease or previous chest trauma. Patients typically present dyspnea associated with acute onset of sharp and steady pleutiric chest pain of variable severity (which resolves within 24h even though pneumothorax is still present). Reflex tachycardia and/or respiratory or circulatory compromise may be observed. Other syndromes (e.g. Birt-Hogg-Dube, Marfan or Ehlers-Danlos syndromes) may be associated.

Clinical features depend on the anatomic variability of the lesion and patients may be minimally symptomatic, severely cyanotic or may develop congestive heart failure. PA-VSD may represent a severe form of Tetralogy of Fallot.

master.definition_en: A spectrum of malignant tumors, affecting mostly males under age 20, characterized morphologically by the presence of small round cells. Ewing sarcoma and peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor represent the ends of a spectrum, with Ewing sarcoma lacking evidence of neural differentiation and the markers that characterize the peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor. Ewing sarcoma and peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor may share cytogenetic abnormalities, proto-oncogene expression, cell culture and immunohistochemical abnormalities. These tumors may occur in the soft tissues or the bones. Pain and the presence of a mass are the most common clinical symptoms.

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
